title: Where and when does the PITCH semi-final run now?
summary: The semi-final was set for Wednesday 11 November, 17:00 to 18:00, Centre Stage (Web Summit's own session page, read 02:55 on 11 Nov). Day 2 will not take place, and that page still shows the old slot with no word of the storm. Where and when it runs now has not been announced.
closes: A Web Summit page that gives the semi-final's day, time and place after the closure.
